budget_items.topic: MSBA Middle/High school project total budget and cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Building Committee chair reported the project total budget, the amount expended, and that it came in about four million dollars under budget.
budget_items.quote: the total budget was $72,975,321.00. we expended $68,106,475.

budget_items.topic: Estimated town share of the school project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Building Committee chair said the town share will be around a stated figure, with MSBA deciding what is reimbursable.
budget_items.quote: the town share will be around $38,809,377.

budget_items.topic: MSBA reimbursements to date and total cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Director said the total cost was the amount expended and MSBA had reimbursed a stated amount to date.
budget_items.quote: the total cost was $68,106,475. msba has reimbursed $32,233,840 to date.

budget_items.topic: MSBA balance owed and anticipated final reimbursement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Director reported a balance owed from the last requisition, the withheld final payment, and the anticipated MSBA reimbursement.
budget_items.quote: the anticipated reimbursement from the final payment of $172,455.23 that you are withholding

budget_items.topic: Total MSBA receipts and total local share
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Director projected total MSBA receipts after final reimbursement and the total local share expended.
budget_items.quote: once we have received everything from msba the total received will be $32,642,234.

budget_items.topic: Bonds issued and remaining amount to bond
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Director reported bonds issued and other sources applied to the project, leaving a final balance to bond that depends on the MSBA audit.
budget_items.quote: is $33,809,377, leaving a final balance to bond at $1,654,863.

budget_items.topic: Bond anticipation note and projected interest rate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $2,100,000 bond anticipation note will carry the project through the audit, and the financial advisor projects 4% interest on long-term bonds.
budget_items.quote: we have the $2,100,000 bond anticipation note to carry us through to the end of the project and the audit.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed accounts payable and payroll warrants in stated amounts.
budget_items.quote: they signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $439,019.64, an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $3,000
